summary.zh: 从电离辐射到MuSC、FAP、免疫、血管/内皮和ECM结局；母图只保留经过核查的粗粒度关系。
summary.en: From ionizing radiation to MuSC, FAP, immune, vascular/endothelial and ECM outcomes; the mother map keeps only audited coarse-grained relations.

summary.zh: 电离辐射首先进入DNA损伤与氧化应激背景。
summary.en: Ionizing radiation enters a DNA-damage and oxidative-stress context.

summary.zh: MuSC数量、扩增和分化能力进入受损阶段。
summary.en: MuSC number, expansion and differentiation become impaired.

summary.zh: FAP出现衰老样和促纤维化表型；p-SMAD3只在早期出现。
summary.en: FAPs acquire senescence-like and fibrotic features; p-SMAD3 is early only.

summary.zh: 免疫通讯保留为推断层，血管/内皮显示为证据待补区域。
summary.en: Immune communication remains an inference layer; vascular/endothelial evidence is pending.

title.zh: 再生障碍与纤维化结局

summary.zh: 肌纤维/肌核不足、ECM沉积和纤维化共同出现。
summary.en: Myofiber/myonuclear deficits, ECM deposition and fibrosis appear together.

summary.zh: 进入DNA损伤、MuSC–FAP–ECM和候选干预专题；导航线不表示因果。
summary.en: Open the DNA-damage, MuSC–FAP–ECM and candidate-intervention modules; navigation lines are not causality.

summary.zh: 保留v0.3的核心证据链，并与母图和DNA专题共享MuSC、FAP、ECM节点。
summary.en: The v0.3 evidence core is retained, with shared MuSC, FAP and ECM nodes linking to the mother map and DNA module.

summary.zh: 电离辐射首先触发细胞内氧化应激与损伤反应；具体效应依剂量、组织和细胞而变。
summary.en: Ionizing radiation initiates oxidative and damage responses that depend on dose, tissue and cell type.

title.en: Loss of MuSC number and function

summary.zh: MuSC减少、ROS升高、NO下降；NO供体只有部分救援，不能解释全部增殖缺陷。
summary.en: MuSC loss, higher ROS and lower NO emerge; NO-donor rescue is partial and not the sole explanation.

title.en: Altered FAP state and immune communication

summary.zh: FAP出现衰老样/促纤维化状态；p-SMAD3仅早期亮起，巨噬细胞通讯保持为推断。
summary.en: FAPs acquire senescence-like/profibrotic features; p-SMAD3 is transient and macrophage signaling remains inferred.

summary.zh: 辐射后FAP分泌组整体抑制分化和融合，但决定性分泌因子尚未识别。
summary.en: The post-radiation FAP secretome impairs differentiation and fusion, while the decisive factor remains unknown.

title.zh: 长期生长不足与纤维化

summary.zh: 再生储备不足与间质重塑共同表现为肌纤维/肌核不足、ECM沉积和纤维化。
summary.en: Reduced regenerative reserve and stromal remodeling culminate in myofiber/myonuclear deficits and fibrosis.

summary.zh: 储备MuSC、再生时序和动物药理干预被分别展示；这些窗口不表示临床疗效已确立。
summary.en: Reserve MuSCs, regeneration timing and animal pharmacology are shown separately; none establishes clinical efficacy.

summary.zh: 将直接肌肉细胞证据、经典DNA损伤通路和候选抗氧化窗口分开显示。
summary.en: Direct muscle-cell evidence, canonical DNA-damage pathways and candidate redox windows are separated.

summary.zh: γH2AX/53BP1是损伤与修复动力学标志，不等同于每一个未修复断裂。
summary.en: γH2AX/53BP1 mark damage and repair kinetics; they are not synonymous with every unrepaired break.

summary.zh: 肌肉细胞模型中可观察到ATM、H2AX、MRE11/Nbs1和Chk2反应。
summary.en: ATM, H2AX, MRE11/Nbs1 and Chk2 responses are observed in muscle-cell models.

summary.zh: 增殖肌母细胞可进入细胞周期阻滞或凋亡；终末肌管不能直接套用。
summary.en: Proliferating myoblasts may enter arrest or apoptosis; terminal myotubes cannot be treated as equivalent.

title.zh: ROS、线粒体与自噬并行反应
title.en: Parallel ROS, mitochondrial and autophagy responses

summary.zh: ROS/RNS、线粒体代谢重塑和自噬是并行观察，不拼接成单一路径。
summary.en: ROS/RNS, mitochondrial remodeling and autophagy are parallel observations, not one stitched pathway.

title.zh: 修复动力学与MuSC功能不足
title.en: Repair kinetics and MuSC functional deficit

summary.zh: 损伤标志与扩增/分化不足在同一模型中出现，但中介关系仍需功能验证。
summary.en: Damage markers and expansion/differentiation deficits co-occur, while mediation still needs functional testing.

summary.zh: NRF2按经典通路和SFN摘要级动物研究显示为条件性窗口，不是临床疗效。
summary.en: NRF2 is shown as a conditional window from canonical biology and an abstract-level SFN animal study, not clinical efficacy.

summary.zh: 血管与内皮反应证据仍在补充；此专题先给出骨架节点与已核查的灌注、EV促血管生成证据，其余留作证据待补。
summary.en: Vessel and endothelial evidence is still being assembled; this module seeds scaffold nodes with the audited perfusion and EV-angiogenesis evidence, leaving the rest pending.

summary.zh: 局部照射后早期微血管/灌注改变的证据有限。
summary.en: Evidence for early microvascular/perfusion change after local irradiation is limited.

summary.zh: 照射MPC的EV丧失促血管生成功能；其余内皮—MuSC耦合待补。
summary.en: EVs from irradiated MPCs lose pro-angiogenic function; other endothelium–MuSC coupling is pending.

summary.zh: 免疫通讯目前主要是单细胞推断层；此专题保留A11推断关系并标出尚待因果验证的骨架节点。
summary.en: Immune communication is currently an inference layer; this module keeps the A11 inferred relation and marks scaffold nodes awaiting causal proof.

summary.zh: 照射后单核/巨噬细胞动态改变主要来自单细胞推断。
summary.en: Post-irradiation monocyte/macrophage dynamics come mainly from single-cell inference.

summary.zh: CellChat推断的TGF-β1→TGFBR2通讯，尚无敲除/中和验证。
summary.en: CellChat-inferred TGF-β1→TGFBR2 communication, without knockout/neutralization proof.

summary.zh: 连接DNA专题的p53/p21与FAP衰老样表型；骨架节点标出SASP等待补证据。
summary.en: Links the DNA module p53/p21 to the senescence-like FAP phenotype; scaffold nodes mark SASP as pending.

summary.zh: 照射肌肉中可见持续Cdkn1a/p21信号。
summary.en: A persistent Cdkn1a/p21 signature is seen in irradiated muscle.

summary.zh: FAP呈衰老样、促纤维化表型；具体SASP因子待补。
summary.en: FAPs show a senescence-like, profibrotic phenotype; specific SASP factors are pending.

summary.zh: 细胞外囊泡与miRNA在辐射肌肉损伤中的作用；此专题给出已核查的照射MPC-EV证据与非辐射参照，推断与候选分层显示。
summary.en: EV and miRNA roles in radiation muscle injury; this module seeds audited irradiated MPC-EV evidence with non-radiation references, layering inference and candidates.

summary.zh: 照射MPC的EV改变miRNA货物并丧失促增殖/促血管生成功能。
summary.en: EVs from irradiated MPCs shift miRNA cargo and lose pro-proliferative/angiogenic function.

title.en: Tumor EVs and candidate EV therapy

summary.zh: 肿瘤来源sEV可远程致肌无力；健康/新生EV作为候选修复，标为非辐射或待证实。
summary.en: Tumor sEVs can drive distant muscle weakness; healthy/neonatal EVs are candidates, marked non-radiation or unproven.
